visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman wearing a pink baseball cap and a pink sleeveless top stands in a sunlit outdoor area in Dubai. She speaks directly to the camera with an enthusiastic expression, gesturing with her hands. The background features modern architecture and palm trees under bright natural daylight. (2) A sleek black Rolls-Royce Ghost drives into a covered hotel driveway. A chauffeur in a dark uniform and sunglasses exits the vehicle and walks to the rear to open the door. (3) The woman enters the car, highlighting the unique rear-hinged door mechanism. On-screen graphics and split-screen comparisons illustrate the difference between standard doors and Rolls-Royce doors. The car interior is beige leather with polished wood accents. (4) Inside the rear cabin, the woman demonstrates luxury features. She lowers a wood-grain tray table and opens a center console compartment revealing champagne glasses and a small refrigerator. The camera focus shifts to the chrome seat adjustment controls. (5) The camera pans upward to show the Starlight Headliner on the ceiling, filled with fiber-optic lights. A brief exterior shot shows the Spirit of Ecstasy ornament on the car's hood as it moves along a highway. (6) A man in sunglasses sits beside her in the back seat. They both point at the embroidered Rolls-Royce logo on the headrests. The woman leans her head back and pretends to sleep with a playful expression. (7) A quick montage shows a row of luxury cars in various colors including red, black, and gold parked outdoors. (8) The scene shifts to a real estate showroom. The woman and an assistant stand over a large architectural model of a beachfront development. A hand points to specific luxury villas and miniature yachts on the model while the woman looks on.
